db:info.db:title: Connector Class
db:info.db:titleabbrev: Tests that template container parameters appear with generic signatures

db:abstract.db:para: A class for testing Q_QDOC-style template parameter overloads.

db:section.db:title: Detailed Description
db:section.db:para: Connector exercises the code path in findNodeForCursor where two overloads differ only in template parameter names, such as Functor vs PointerToMemberFunction. Without the TemplateTypeParmType guard, canonical comparison collapses both names to type-parameter-0-0, causing one overload to shadow the other.

db:section.db:title: template <typename PointerToMemberFunction> void Connector::invoke(PointerToMemberFunction callback, int priority)
db:section.db:para: Invokes callback with the given priority.
